verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-incorporation service (Delaware entity formation, EIN, 83(b) filings, legal documents, banking setup). User-authored automations that can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back are outside this product category. Atlas's built-in automatic steps, such as filing Form SS-4 or 83(b) elections, are fixed service actions rather than user-managed automations, and nothing in the evidence shows such a feature.
